name: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Ltd

facts.business: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Limited provides civil engineering consultancy services including land surveying, topographic and other engineering surveying using modern techniques, engineering design, detailed project reports, cost estimates, financial & economic appraisal, project management consultancy, town planning, land use and e-governance portal services for aiding government in planning civil construction jobs of all types including roads, bridges, buildings, railways, and city infrastructure.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure for purchase of machinery
